description: This file provides an asynchronous client interface for interacting with the Ollama REST API, specifically for text generation and health checks. It includes functions to send prompts to the API and handle potential errors gracefully, utilizing application settings for configuration.

methods.name: Optional[str] generate_text( prompt: str, model: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a prompt to the Ollama /api/generate endpoint, returning generated text or None on failure.

methods.name: bool check_ollama_health()
methods.description: Performs a health check by sending a GET request to the Ollama base URL and returns True if the service is responsive.

ctags.signature: ( prompt: str, model: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[int] = None, )
